items.t: Airbag light from spilled drinks or seat wiring contact
items.job: Repair airbag wiring and connectors, clear codes
items.note: Usually free under the recalls. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer first.

items.t: Front lower control arms rust through
items.note: Price is per side. Check your VIN for the control arm recall first. An alignment is usually needed after.
Often free under Hyundai's brake light switch recall. Check your VIN first.

items.job: Recalibrate or replace passenger occupant sensor
items.note: Free under the recalls. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: ABS module can short and start a fire
items.note: The recall fix is free and is often a new fuse or module. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Piston slap and cylinder wall scuffing
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured long block
items.note: Mild cold-start noise alone may not need repair. Ask a dealer about extended engine coverage for your VIN.

items.job: Replace transmission input or output speed sensor
items.note: Check the wiring per the bulletin first. If the transmission must be replaced, expect much more.
The anti-theft software update is free at Hyundai dealers. Price is for fixing an ignition damaged in a theft attempt.
Covered by Hyundai's extended engine warranty if the knock-sensor update was done. Check your VIN with a dealer.

items.job: Replace ignition coil and spark plugs
items.note: Ask the shop to check the bulletin first. If the cause is inside the engine, expect much more.
A software update sometimes fixes it. Ask the dealer about the dual-clutch bulletins and any extended clutch coverage.

items.t: Oil burning from faulty piston rings
items.note: Check your VIN for the piston ring recall. Covered engines are inspected and replaced free.
Usually done free under Hyundai's powertrain warranty for original owners.

items.t: Seat belt pretensioner can burst in a crash
items.note: Free under the recall. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.
Often covered by Hyundai's powertrain warranty for original owners. Ask the dealer about the bulletin first.
